ic_name: LIN bus 2.2A (Local Interconnect Network, LIN Consortium)
test_cases_present: partial - the LIN spec defines protocol behaviour and a per-frame conformance signal (response_error) but does not enumerate stand-alone bench test vectors. Conformance tests are derived from the must-have / must-not-have properties (L16) and the behavioural sequences (L12).
derived_compliance_test_categories: Reset behavior: enable bit cleared; transmit-empty flag set; receive-flag cleared after reset.
Master mode transmission: write to data register + clock-cycle delay + N edges + receive-flag set.
Slave mode transmission: select line goes LOW + N edges from master + receive-flag set after last edge.
